steps.title: A real shielded wallet
steps.text: A zcash-devtool wallet on a regtest chain run by Zebra (consensus) and Zaino (the lightwalletd-compatible server). It pays Bob 1.5 ZEC from its Orchard pool with an encrypted memo, and Bob's wallet decrypts it.
steps.output:
[2mspendable Orchard: 68974930000 zatoshis[0m
[2mpaid bob 1.5 with an encrypted memo: 6ac0f68ebbf41763…[0m
[2mbob's wallet decrypts the memo:[0m
    Memo: Memo::Text("rent October")

steps.title: Seal it into a capsule
steps.text: Hermit captures the scanned wallet database and seals it with age to every authorized device. The spend key is included here only because we asked for it, still locked to the wallet's own identity file. Below the output is the start of what the relay actually stores: ciphertext.

steps.title: A new phone joins
steps.text: The laptop prints a QR code and a nine-digit code. The phone joins, sees the same code, checks every signature back to the genesis, checks the anchor block against the chain, and restores. Nothing needs rescanning: the restored wallet is already at the tip, with the same address.

steps.title: The phone keeps spending
steps.text: The restored wallet is a full wallet, not a view-only copy. It pays Bob again, and Bob's wallet decrypts the memo.
steps.output:
[2mthe phone paid bob 0.25 with an encrypted memo: f7ab2ed0ccd65556…[0m
[2mbob's wallet decrypts the memo:[0m
    Memo: Memo::Text("sent from my new phone via Hermit")

steps.title: Another app, through ZeWIF
steps.text: The phone exports the wallet as a view-only ZeWIF document. zcash_client_sqlite's own importer, the code Zallet and the mobile SDKs build on, turns it into a new wallet that syncs to the identical set of transactions. It cannot spend: adoption is view-only by design.

steps.title: Storage is not authority
steps.text: The relay hides the laptop's newest change, and the phone catches it because the witness has attested a newer head. A wallet synced from a lying server is refused before anything is signed. Two devices change who is in charge at the same time, and Hermit stops instead of guessing; a person resolves it.
